name: Miso salmon & bok choy broth
steps: Bring the vegetable broth to a gentle simmer in a small pot.
Add the sliced shiitake and simmer for three minutes.
Add the bok choy and cook until just tender.
Stir the miso paste into a ladle of broth off the heat, then return it to the pot.
Flake in the cooked salmon and warm through.
Scatter with sliced spring onion and serve.
